Title: Daemonic Posessions new wording makes no sense.

Messages.Author: Hobbesgoblin
Messages.Body:
I have no other words of puting this, and am not even sure if this is the right forum, feel free to moce of this belongs somewhere else.

Daemonic Posessions current and new wording makes no sense and should be changed.

Old:

new:

the old wording is very clear of how it works.
The new wording says "Choose a minion controlled by another Methuselah who has been burned since your last turn."
But per the rules, no such minion can exist in the ash heap, since all minions in the ash heap are always uncontrolled, since the ash heap is not part of the controlled region.

Messages.Author: mjvtes521
Messages.Body: Good point. Quick fix could just be, “Choose a minion in another Methusaleh’s ash heap that has been burned since your last turn…..”

Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
The quick fix would incurr a small functional change: per the old wording (which probably reflects the intention of the card as opposed to the new wording) it would be possible to move a minion from your ash heap to the ready region, if that minion was controlled by another methuselah when it burned.

Prince of Bonn, Germany
